title: Story premise ENT042: The Rain-Sorting Rooftops
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: Every drop keeps choosing the same address. Takeaway/theme: A sequence can redirect a flow when each stage is ready.
description: A block village wants to fill three decorative ponds, but one roof sends all toy rain beads into the first basin. As each basin reaches its marked level, a floating block tips a channel toward the next, ending with a row of tiny flags instead of an overflowing plaza.
